remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offering comfort, convenience, and thoughtful design.  The home features hardwood floors on both levels, a bright kitchen with a charming breakfast area, a separate dining room, and a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace. Sliding doors lead to a private porch-perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with ample closet space and a private bath. This unit also includes in-unit laundry, an attached garage, and additional storage space.  Enjoy plenty of parking, well-kept grounds, and a truly welcoming setting surrounded by mature trees.   Excellent credit required. Two months' security deposit. No pets or smoking permitted.
